behavior.living_phase_contract: product-state faces get sparse whole-face phase motion by adjusting face shift, eye width/opening, highlight, mouth scale, and cheeks without storing extra frames
behavior.memory_contract: comp_pet_behavior_memory_t is a target-owned, CRC/wear-aware external user-data payload; portable behavior never writes Flash
behavior.premium_art_contract: generated-art principles are translated into procedural one-bit features: rounded pet nose/mouth, hollow thought bubbles, soft listening waves, tiny record dot, and small spark marks
behavior.refresh_contract: behavior advances at real product-event or touch boundaries; it does not schedule an idle animation loop

event_bridge.daily_stroke: left/right/up/down logical finger travel becomes a direction-specific full-face response and bounded emotional update while the reserved menu-edge gesture keeps priority
event_bridge.daily_touch: continuous logical touch coordinates update engagement and become a three-phase attentive response pose
event_bridge.product_state: all ten ExpressionV1 states advance a bounded valence/arousal/curiosity/affection/attachment mood model before composing a pose

purpose: Machine-checkable architecture contract for the portable parameterized electronic-pet face.
refresh_policy: interactive differential refresh during contact; one generic quiet maintenance pass after the pet or menu has settled; full refresh remains boot/recovery only

renderer.logical_coordinate_space: 200x200 logical coordinates scaled to every framebuffer at or above 64x64

resource_policy.external: CEMP keeps replaceable timelines, menu art, fonts, and larger product assets in ui_assets; emotion memory belongs in a separate target-owned user-data partition
resource_policy.internal: pet_behavior and pet_expression are compact deterministic application code and render into the existing framebuffer only

wba_port: Reuse pose and renderer; replace only panel transport/profile facts in target-named adapters.
